# DS-02: Data Acquisition and Sourcing (Tier 1)

**Subtrack:** Data Science  
**Unit scope:** APIs, open-data portals, ethical web collection, file formats, provenance and licensing.

## Assessments

Pick **any one**. Every assessment here is an independent, complete demonstration of this unit at this tier.

| ID | Title | Format | Domain | Est. time | Compute | Difficulty (T M R E A Res) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`DS-T1-004`](DS-T1-004-every-page-exactly-once/README.md) | Every Page, Exactly Once: A Resilient Client for the World Bank Indicators API | Implementation | energy-access, development-indicators, open-government-data | 10–16 h | CPU, offline-capable | T3 M1 R1 E3 A2 R1 |

- **[DS-T1-004](DS-T1-004-every-page-exactly-once/README.md): Every Page, Exactly Once: A Resilient Client for the World Bank Indicators API.** Build a paginated World Bank API client with retries, jittered backoff, an integrity-checked cache and a provenance log. It must survive the API's real traps (HTTP-200 errors, nulls, republished vintages) and is tested fully offline against recorded responses and a fault-injecting fake server.
- **[DS-T1-005](DS-T1-005-four-agencies-one-price/README.md): Four Agencies, One Price: Parsing and Reconciling Heterogeneous Food-Price Files.** Parse JSON, XML, a multi-sheet Excel workbook and a legacy fixed-width file describing the same staple-food prices into one canonical table. Then classify each surviving cross-agency anomaly as a parsing error, a source defect or a real market event, with evidence.
